title: Koto — native translator for macOS
og_title: Koto — translate and stay in the flow
description: Koto by Slipcast-Dev: translate text, selections and screen regions on Mac. Apple Translation, optional Qwen and a Chrome extension. Download the alpha for Apple Silicon.
og_description: Text, selections and screen regions in one native Mac app.
headline: Translate.
section_caption: At home in your Mac workflow.
capture_body: Select text in an app or capture a screen region. Koto recognizes it and translates it.
engine_body: Built-in Apple Translation and optional Qwen. Choose the translation engine that suits you.
chrome_body: Translate selections and visible page content with the extension and the app on your Mac.
privacy_title: Your text stays under your control.
privacy_body: Cloud translation is enabled separately. Memory is off by default.
alpha: Without Apple notarization: macOS may block the app from opening. Some workflows are still being tested.
